response.overview: It seems that the amazingly talented director Monsieur Martial Amaury (The Dark Side of Angels) is not only France's finest young genius behind the camera, but also something of an amateur psychologist. He wanted to know what his camera would capture were he to go camping in the virgin forest with sixteen handsome and extremely well-endowed young French men. He was glad that he brought plenty of film because once free of the pressure of Parisian life in the big city, these guys got down to some serious, sweaty, semen-soaked sex! Now experience this offering of extraordinary work from an extraordinary man. . . in the open!
response.tagline: These camping boys just can't stop! 7 days and 7 nights sucking it up and drilling holes like crazy!!!
response.title: Sept Nuits sous les étoiles
